The real question is whether the Petitioner's participation in the statutory payment mechanism amounts to an unequivocal relinquishment of its right to pursue the disputed balance LPS under the PPA.

40. It is a settled principle that waiver involves the intentional and unequivocal abandonment of a known legal right. Such intention must be clear, conscious and unequivocal. A reservation of rights made contemporaneously with acceptance of payment is fundamentally inconsistent with any inference that the party intended to abandon its remaining claim. In the present case, the Petitioner's acceptance of the payment mechanism was expressly qualified by a reservation that the disputed balance LPS would be pursued separately. In these circumstances, we cannot accept the Respondents' contention that the Petitioner waived its claim.

The acceptance of payment under the LPS Rules, 2022, accompanied by an express reservation of rights, cannot operate as a bar to adjudication of the disputed balance claim.

47. We have considered the above submissions. The Respondents' objection proceeds on the premise that the Petitioner is not entitled to the differential LPS claimed in the present Petition. However, while deciding Issue Nos. (A) to (C), we have already held that the Respondents were not justified in postponing the Due Date by linking it to the completion of verification of the Supplementary Bills, that the Petitioner is entitled to the differential LPS computed in accordance with the PPA, and that acceptance of payment under the LPS Rules, 2022 does not extinguish the Petitioner's claim. Consequently, the very foundation of the Respondents' objection does not survive.
